carbonAccounting.title: Carbon Accounting: from measurement to strategy
carbonAccounting.subtitle: Carbon accounting is a structuring tool for any organization. It allows measuring greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, understanding their origin and defining a credible reduction trajectory. With CarboScan, we combine the methodological rigor of Carbon Footprint® and the power of our economic simulator.

steps.title: Key steps of a Carbon Footprint®

step1.title: Scope definition
step1.description: Determine which activities, sites and value chains will be analyzed (Scopes 1, 2 and 3).

step2.title: Data collection (the decisive step)
step2.description: This is the foundation of the process: we identify and collect all relevant data (energy consumption, travel, inputs, purchases, freight, waste, fixed assets, etc.).

step3.title: Measurement and calculation of emissions
step3.description: Thanks to our platform, collected data is automatically converted into GHG emissions (tCO₂e) according to recognized methodology (ADEME Carbon Base and international standards).

step4.title: Analysis and reporting
step4.description: Results are presented in clear reports, with carbon intensity indicators (per employee, m², unit produced). The analysis highlights the most emitting items.

step5.title: Action plan and prioritization
step5.description: We identify reduction levers (energy, mobility, purchases, industrial processes) and propose concrete actions ranked according to their carbon impact.

step6.title: CarboScan economic simulation
step6.description: Our simulator evaluates: the current cost of your emissions (€ / tCO₂e), the financial impact of future regulations (CBAM, carbon taxation), savings generated by each reduction action.

step7.title: Monitoring and Net Zero trajectory
step7.description: Periodic reviews allow measuring progress made and adjusting the reduction trajectory towards a Net Zero objective.

tips.entreprise: Industry sector and company size heavily influence the carbon profile. Service SMEs emit on average 5 to 15 tCO₂e per employee per year.
tips.energie: Heating and cooling often represent 20-40% of a building's emissions. Switching to natural gas or renewable electricity can reduce the footprint by 30 to 70%.
tips.flotte: A conventional vehicle emits on average 2.6 tCO₂e per year for 15,000 km. Switching to electric can divide emissions by 3 to 4.
tips.deplacements: A Paris-New York round trip emits about 1.75 tCO₂e per passenger. Trains emit 50 times less CO₂ than planes over the same distances.
tips.achats: Purchases and subcontracting are often the largest emission source (Scope 3). Favoring local suppliers can reduce this footprint by 15 to 25%.
tips.dechets: Think refurbished! A laptop emits 942 kg of CO₂e, a smartphone 79 kg and a television 371 kg. Extending their lifespan significantly reduces your score.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: We believe that the transition to a low-carbon economy depends on companies' ability to understand and master their environmental footprint. In a context where regulations are intensifying and stakeholder expectations are evolving, organizations must equip themselves with reliable, simple and effective tools to measure, monitor and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions. CarboScan was founded to meet this need by offering a professional digital solution, designed to be both accessible and rigorous.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is to support companies — from SMEs to large organizations — in managing their carbon impact. We provide solutions adapted to each stage of their approach: from initial assessment to action plan definition, through progress monitoring. CarboScan acts as a true strategic partner, enabling companies to integrate carbon management into their governance and daily practices.
